text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our day off after the final day of summer training camp, Dantsu Flame and I visited a certain town.
It was packed with all kinds of attractions, from museums and art galleries to a zoo.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there's so much to do here...! Where should we start?
Wherever you want to go, Trainer, anywhere at all—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...No. Since we're here today,
why don't we go to the places both of us want to visit?
choice_data_list: Sounds great. Let's start with where you want to go!
Sounds great. Let's start with where you want to go!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Okay...! In that case—!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Wah, look! There are elephants, bears, and even little otters~!
choice_data_list: You really love animals, don't you, Dantsu?
You really love animals, don't you, Dantsu?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I do! Just watching them eat and lounge around so peacefully,
or stare straight at you with those round, bead-like eyes...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's just so soothing to watch~.
...Ah! Look, a little penguin is waddling this way!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's flapping its wings up and down...
Do you think it might be waving at us?
choice_data_list: Animals must really take a liking to you.
Animals must really take a liking to you.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
! Y-You think so? Ehehe...
Oh, but... now that you mention it—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I went to a dog cafe before, and so many of the puppies
gathered around me! It was so adorable!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Though so many came over that it was a little overwhelming... Ahaha...
choice_data_list: They must be drawn to your gentle aura.
They must be drawn to your gentle aura.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
M-Maybe~. But... if that's true, it makes me really happy!
Could that little penguin feel it too...? Hehe, just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Bye-bye, little penguin! I'll come visit you again~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah, what a lovely cafe...!
It gets so much sun, and sitting out on the terrace looks so nice!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, so this is where you wanted to come, Trainer.
choice_data_list: They filmed one of my favorite dramas here.
They filmed one of my favorite dramas here.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...!
Um, what kind of drama is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a legal drama about prosecutors that my parents were hooked on when I was a kid. I didn't understand it back then, but now that I'm older, I've come to appreciate how good it is.
choice_data_list: It's a legal drama about prosecutors, with a pretty deep story.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a prosecutor drama...!
Hehe, that somehow feels very fitting for you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: You think so?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I always picture prosecutors as people driven by strong convictions!
So it makes total sense that you'd like it~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Um, what kind of scenes in it do you like best?
I'd love to hear all about it, if you don't mind!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And we're back~! Phew, we've walked around almost the entire area.
...The time just flew right by.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
We walked so much and talked about so many things. Getting to learn
about your favorite drama and everything... I had so much fun!
choice_data_list: I was really happy to hear about your favorite things too, Dantsu.
I was really happy to hear about your favorite things too, Dantsu.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! .........Ah, that reminds me!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... do you have time tonight?
There's a fireworks festival nearby later today. If you'd like...
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go together!
Yeah, let's go together!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Trainer, that yukata looks so good on you!
It's such a calm, mature color...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. But since we came all the way to a fireworks festival, maybe a little flair...
I know! If we go with a bolder pattern for the obi—pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
! Wow, that looks great! It's mature and gentle, but the sash adds a nice, sharp touch...
It suits you perfectly, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I'm glad to hear that. Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it! ...Um, Trainer!
There's a yukata design I've had my eye on too, but...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I-I just... can't decide on the color...
If... if you don't mind! Trainer... would you pick one out for me?
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dressed in our yukata, we set off together for the festival.
And the place we finally arrived at was—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da! It's a secret spot. I actually found it last year...
There's nobody here, and you get an amazing view!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
We did so much walking today...
So let's take our time and enjoy the fireworks to finish it off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reflect quietly on the view she's shared with me.
A gentle summer breeze suddenly caresses my cheek.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
......
...Trainer. Um, how was today?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I had a wonderful time.
Yeah, it was so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
! I'm so glad.
I had a lot of fun too. Getting to visit all kinds of places with you.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...
Um, Trainer. I...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BOOM! KA-BOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! The fireworks are starting~~!! Hey, what do you think?
From here, it's so easy to see... they look even prettier than usual...!
choice_data_list: Yeah! They're amazing!
Yeah! They're so gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. So that's the kind of face you make when watching fireworks, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Huh, was I making a weird face?
Wait, did I look funny?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No, no, not at all!
...It was a lovely expression. One I've never seen before.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd learned so much about you today, Trainer...
but I guess I still have a long way to go—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: And I'm sure you probably feel the same about me—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
choice_data_list: ...Dantsu?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
If it's okay with you... I'd love to do something like this again.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The things I like. The things you like.
I want us to share lots of them together—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
More and more.
I want to get to know you... and I want you to know me too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: What... do you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I remember how she reached out her hand just like this when we signed our contract.
Filled with fond nostalgia, I extend my hand as well.
choice_data_list: Of course. ...I'm looking forward to working with you, Dantsu.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes! ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer's hand is so warm and gentle today, too.
Just like when we shook hands back then.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(But will there come a day... when that warmth feels different?
If that ever happens—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (I hope I can feel it just like this again. ...I'd really love to know.)
